newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco do Brasil loses 7.52 bln reais in '96.
newsitem.headline: Banco do Brasil loses 7.52 bln reais in '96.

text.p: Brazilian federal bank Banco do Brasil said it reported a record net loss of 7.52 billion reais in 1996.
In the second half, the bank showed a profit of 254.9 million reais, equivalent to an annualized return on shareholder equity of 9.3 percent, it said in a statement.
Banco do Brasil said its 1996 loss was equivalent to a loss of 10.57 reais per 1,000 shares. In 1995, the bank reported a 4.2 billion real loss.
In December last year, Banco do Brasil's profit was 70.2 million reais, the bank added.

"The gains reported during the second semester were, as previously estimated, insufficient to reverse the losses posted during the first half associated with the bank's structural adjustment program," the bank said in the statement.
It added that the bank's net worth at the end of 1996 was 5.59 billion reais.
Further details were to be given at a news conference.
